import re
ttl = open(GRAPH_TTL).read()
# Split into triples-ish per subject. Simple: find point URIs that are isPointOf a Zone.
# We'll parse blocks: a subject line is a line ending with ' ;' or '.' that is NOT indented.
# Simpler: iterate matches of "bldg:...Sensor a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor" etc and gather until next blank-subject.

def parse_blocks(text):
    # split on blank lines
    out=[]
    cur=""
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if not line.strip():
            if cur.strip():
                out.append(cur)
            cur=""
        else:
            cur+=line+"\n"
    if cur.strip(): out.append(cur)
    return out

blocks = parse_blocks(ttl)
temp_map={}   # zone -> series for Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor
cool_map={}   # zone -> series for Zone_Air_Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint
for b in blocks:
    m_type = re.search(r'a\s+(brick:[\w]+)', b)
    m_ref = re.search(r'ref:hasExternalReference\s*<([^>]+)>', b)
    m_ipo = re.search(r'brick:isPointOf\s*(bldg:(\S+))', b)
    if not m_type: continue
    t=m_type.group(1)
    if t in ('brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor',) and m_ipo and m_ref:
        temp_map[m_ipo.group(2)] = m_ref.group(1)
    if t in ('brick:Zone_Air_Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint',) and m_ipo and m_ref:
        cool_map[m_ipo.group(2)] = m_ref.group(1)

print("temps", len(temp_map))
print("cools", len(cool_map))
zones = sorted(set(temp_map)&set(cool_map))
for z in zones:
    print(z, temp_map[z], cool_map[z])
